description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC

At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.

Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.

We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil

What The Role Involves

The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.

What We’re Looking For

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.

Hy Cite is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, recognizing that it builds stronger teams. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take our responsibility seriously to consider qualified applicants on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, citizenship, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by applicable law.

description:
Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender as necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.

A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop.

Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Sobre a vaga:

A área de Estratégia de Negócios da BU de Empréstimos do PicPay faz uma análise completa dos usuários e de seus dados bancários compartilhados para oferecer soluções de crédito adequadas. Para cada perfil de usuário e propensão, procuramos a melhor oferta.Nosso papel é maximizar os resultados de receita gerada pelos empréstimos, sempre de forma sustentável e colocando as necessidades dos usuários em primeiro lugar. O desafio dessa posição é usar o conhecimento e vivência de produtos e negócios (produtos parcelados é um "plus") para ajudar o crescimento do negócio, oferecendo aos nossos usuários a melhor a oferta de crédito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Terá o papel de identificar formas de otimizar o fluxo de empréstimos sem garantia, medindo e testando a jornada do usuário, buscando incrementar a eficiência dos processos e políticas, além de buscar novas alternativas e flexibilizações que tragam benefício aos usuários. É muito importante ser capaz de compreender as implicações de uma proposta de novos produtos/negócios, sendo eficiente e preciso na análise. Fará o acompanhamento do P&L do produto, garantindo que nossas soluções otimizem receita, custos e despesas para a empresa. No dia a dia irá também acompanhar, coordenar e garantir o andamento dos projetos da área e inter-áreas com pouca supervisão.

Manipulação base de dados (principalmente SQL);

Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros;

Perfil analítico, com excelente capacidade de interpretar dados e observar tendências;

Além desse espírito de inovação, é essencial que você tenha boa capacidade de lidar com diferentes áreas e inclusive tocar o dia a dia com parceiros quando necessário;

Atuação em projetos que demonstre habilidade de organização, planejamento, comunicação clara/objetiva e estruturada.

description:
Conheça a 1GLOBAL

A 1GLOBAL é uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora que atua na interseção entre telecomunicações e tecnologia. Fundada por dois empreendedores visionários, Hakan Koç e Pyrros Koussios, a 1GLOBAL é uma empresa privada com uma missão clara: conectar o mundo de forma integrada e eficiente . Com mais de 100 milhões de dólares em receita e um crescimento contínuo, somos uma empresa sólida e independente, capaz de financiar nossa expansão de maneira sustentável.

Como provedora global especializadas em telecomunicações, a 1GLOBAL atende diversas áreas como instituições financeiras, operadoras de redes móveis e consumidores em 42 países. Oferecemos serviços regulados de voz, dados e SMS. Somos pioneiros na revolução de eSIMs, construindo um ecossistema completo que nos impulsiona ao lado de parceiros como Apple, Palo Alto Networks e Google, além de clientes renomados como Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Revolut, Netflix e Tesla.
E agora, estamos abrindo um Hub de Tecnologia em São Paulo, Brasil e buscamos talentos que estejam dispostos a nos ajudar a conectar o mundo de forma integrada.

Junte-se a nós!


Sobre a vaga!

Estamos à procura de um(a) líder de engenharia talentoso(a) e experiente para integrar o nosso time do Consumer Group. Você será responsável por construir e liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada na entrega e gestão contínua de nossos produtos B2C (como o betterroaming.com ) e B2B2C (API que alimenta plataformas como Revolut, NordVPN , entre outras). Você fará parte de um time talentoso, curioso e disposto a experimentar novas tecnologias. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe e cultivamos uma cultura de plena responsabilidade sobre nossas entregas, o que significa que somos autônomos e responsáveis por elas.

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por liderar equipes e criar produtos impactantes, queremos te conhecer!

  • Projetar e implementar soluções eficientes e sustentáveis, garantindo as melhores práticas em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de uma arquitetura de microsserviços robusta, escalável e de alto desempenho.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais, incluindo desenvolvedores frontend, gerentes de produto e designers, para traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções backend escaláveis e eficientes.
  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura e contribuir para o design geral do sistema.
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs RESTful para garantir uma comunicação fluida entre os diferentes componentes da nossa plataforma, com foco em segurança, desempenho e confiabilidade das APIs.
  • Projetar e otimizar esquemas de banco de dados, trabalhando de perto com administradores de banco de dados para garantir o armazenamento e recuperação eficientes de dados.
  • Identificar e solucionar gargalos de desempenho nos sistemas backend, continuamente otimizando e melhorando a eficiência do código e dos sistemas existentes.
  • Orientar membros da equipe e contribuir com revisões significativas.

Requisitos

    • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software em Java.
    • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em liderança de engenharia.
    • Bom entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas, serviços em nuvem (AWS) e infraestrutura escalável.
    • Experiência com testes unitários, de integração e e2e (desenvolvimento orientado a testes é um diferencial).
    • Proficiência em APIs REST, tanto na implementação quanto no consumo de interfaces.
    • Experiência sólida com bancos de dados relacionais, fluxos de CI/CD, Git, Docker e Kubernetes.
    • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação (fluente em inglês, tanto escrito quanto falado), com um perfil autônomo e motivado.

Por que escolher a 1GLOBAL?

  • Oportunidades de Crescimento: Avance em sua carreira em uma das empresas de telecomunicações que mais cresce, com expansão de mais de 40% ano a ano sob a liderança de empreendedores de tecnologia.
  • Exposição Global e Multicultura: Você também terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um time multicultural, colaborando com pessoas de diferentes nacionalidades e experiências.
  • Cultura de Comunicação Aberta: Faça parte de uma equipe onde suas ideias são ouvidas e o diálogo é incentivado, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho transparente e colaborativo.
  • Exposição a Grandes Projetos: Participe ativamente de decisões que impactam o futuro da indústria de telecomunicações.
  • Ambiente de Trabalho Dinâmico: Se prepare para estar em um ambiente acelerado e inovador, com pessoas comprometidas em transformar o universo de telecomunicações através de tecnologia.
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Trabalhe ao lado de um time talentoso que se apoie mutuamente, sempre pronto para elevar nosso nível e ajudar você a aprimorar suas habilidades, superando desafios e alcançando estes objetivos juntos.
  • Foco em Resultados: Contribua em um time orientado a resultados, que valoriza eficiência, criatividade e inovação.

Na 1GLOBAL, acreditamos que um ambiente diverso e inclusivo é fundamental para nosso sucesso. Valorizamos diferentes perspectivas e experiências que cada pessoa traz, para criar um espaço de respeito e colaboração. Aqui, buscamos promover uma cultura onde todos se sintam bem-vindos e possam contribuir com seu melhor, independentemente de origem, gênero, orientação sexual, etnia ou qualquer outra característica pessoal. Estamos sempre em busca de criar um ambiente onde todos possam crescer e se desenvolver juntos.

Nossa missão é liderar a transformação industrial, promovendo a inovação e a sustentabilidade. Desde a otimização de data centers e o avanço na produção de hidrogênio até a revolução nos sistemas de refrigeração e HVAC, nossas soluções térmicas essenciais impulsionam indústrias em todo o mundo. Unidos sob o nome "One Kelvion", nosso time global oferece soluções inovadoras que promovem o sucesso dos clientes e apoiam um futuro sustentável.

O papel de Controlador Financeiro atua como um parceiro estratégico fundamental para o Diretor Geral, fornecendo insights financeiros estratégicos para apoiar a tomada de decisões e impulsionar o desempenho do negócio. Essa função é responsável por supervisionar todas as atividades contábeis, garantindo a precisão e integridade dos relatórios financeiros. Além disso, lidera os processos de orçamento, previsões e reportes, assegurando o cumprimento das metas financeiras, além de garantir conformidade regulatória e supervisionar os Controles Internos sobre Relatórios Financeiros (CIRF). O Controlador Financeiro também lidera atividades de TI relacionadas à melhoria dos sistemas financeiros e à gestão de dados, promovendo eficiência operacional.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Contabilidade e Relatórios Financeiros

  • Supervisionar as funções contábeis, garantindo a precisão das conciliações do balanço patrimonial e conduzindo o fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Assegurar a elaboração de relatórios precisos e dentro do prazo, conforme normas IFRS.
  • Gerenciar as equipes de Contabilidade, Contas a Pagar e Contas a Receber.
  • Supervisionar auditorias e controles internos para garantir conformidade e mitigar riscos financeiros.

Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A)

  • Liderar o planejamento financeiro, orçamento e previsões, alinhando com os objetivos corporativos.
  • Analisar tendências de desempenho financeiro, identificando riscos e oportunidades estratégicas.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados, dashboards e análises de variações para monitorar metas financeiras.

Parceria com as Operações

  • Colaborar com lideranças operacionais para iniciativas de redução de custos e eficiência.
  • Apoiar projetos de CAPEX com análises financeiras e acompanhamento de ROI.
  • Trabalhar com equipes de cadeia de suprimentos e compras para identificar oportunidades de economia.

Custeio e Gestão de Fluxo de Caixa

  • Suportar modelos de custeio e análises de precificação.
  • Revisar modelos de fluxo de caixa de novos pedidos para garantir fluxo positivo.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação e influência.
  • Proficiência em modelagem financeira, previsão e análise de cenários.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em ERP (SAP), Excel e normas IFRS.

FORMAÇÃO E EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.
  • CPA, CMA ou MBA preferencial, com registro no CRC.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Ao menos 8 anos de experiência em funções financeiras, com 3 anos em cargos de liderança.

title: Financial Risk Senior Analyst
description:
Sobre o Stark Bank

Você se imagina trabalhando em uma empresa que antecipa o futuro simplificando o presente? Esse é o Stark Bank, banco das empresas que vem crescendo exponencialmente no Brasil.

Nascemos em 2018 e oferecemos a melhor tecnologia para gestão financeira de pagamentos e recebimentos. Temos orgulho de dizer que nossos desenvolvedores criaram uma das APIs mais completas e amigáveis do mercado para oferecer produtos financeiros de forma inovadora.

Apesar de sermos jovens, somos lucrativos desde 2020 e estamos na Serie B, com grandes investidores por trás. Somos a primeira startup brasileira a receber investimentos de um fundo privado do Jeff Bezos, o fundador da Amazon!

Buscamos pessoas que entendam como encantar clientes internos, queiram quebrar recordes e fazer história, construindo o melhor banco do universo!

Sobre a posição:

No time de riscos, você será responsável pela elaboração de indicadores, monitoramento e análise de riscos financeiros e de gestão de capital do Stark Bank, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações vigentes.

Você estará à frente da implementação de modelos de avaliação de risco, projeções de capital e análise de impactos financeiros em cenários macroeconômicos e regulatórios!

Você irá:
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de riscos de mercado, crédito e liquidez, com foco em capital e adequação regulatória (Basileia III, por exemplo);
  • Desenvolver e manter ferramentas e modelos de análise de risco, incluindo ferramentas quantitativas e de visualização de dados, para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  • Gerenciar o cálculo e a projeção de requisitos de capital do banco, com base nas metodologias estabelecidas e mudanças regulatórias;
  • Monitorar e avaliar o impacto de eventos macroeconômicos e alterações regulatórias nos requisitos de capital do banco;
  • Desenvolver modelos e cenários de stress test para simulação de variáveis de risco em diferentes cenários financeiros;
  • Preparar relatórios periódicos para a alta direção e órgãos reguladores, apresentando análises, conclusões e recomendações sobre o risco de capital;
  • Acompanhar e aplicar mudanças na regulamentação de capital e adequação financeira, incluindo as mudanças previstas nas políticas do Bacen e demais órgãos reguladores;
  • Apoiar as áreas internas na definição de estratégias de mitigação de riscos financeiros, colaborando com outras áreas, como Produtos, Tesouraria, Crédito e Compliance.
O que não pode faltar:
  • Formação superior em Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Finanças, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas afins será um diferencial;
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em funções similares, com forte atuação em gestão de risco financeiro, análise de capital e regulação bancária;
  • Profundo conhecimento das normas de adequação de capital (Basileia III), métricas de risco e gestão de capital regulatório;
  • Habilidades analíticas e quantitativas para avaliar cenários de risco e realizar projeções de capital sob diferentes condições econômicas;
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e assertiva, tanto para apresentações para a alta direção quanto para relatórios técnicos;
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas e de modelagem financeira;
  • Inglês avançado.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica e odontológica SulAmerica;
  • VR/VA no Cartão Corporativo Stark;

  • Auxílio moradia (atrelada a política de distância do escritório);

  • Bônus anual.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We have created a new leadership role, Channel Marketing Director, to drive our Go-To-Market strategy across our partner ecosystem, from silicon to public cloud, through channel and hardware manufacturers. As the publisher of Ubuntu and the leading provider of open source to major technology firms globally, we play a unique role in a variety of innovative value chains (Public Cloud, Cybersecurity, AI, IoT) supporting our partners both technically and commercially.
Reporting to the VP of Marketing you will lead a team of marketing managers running partner programs. You will work closely with our partners to make Canonical their trusted partner to deliver open source based products and solutions. In this role you will ultimately be responsible for maximising the overall ROI of our campaigns supporting our partners motions whether sell-to, sell-through or sell-with.
The partner marketing team is formed of multi-talented marketing professionals, as comfortable formulating joint value propositions as they are about running lead generation campaigns. They have an eye for creating remarkable messages/assets and a hand in the selection of the most effective channels through a complex supply chain. They are passionate about technology, the users of enterprise technology, and are early adopters of advanced partner analytics technologies.
Location: This role is home based in the AMER region.
The role entails

  • Building a marketing strategy that drives pipeline growth and revenue outcomes through key partners – Silicon, IHV, ODM, Channel, GSIs, etc.
  • Aligning with growth, field and product marketing to deliver activities integrated with Canonical's campaigns.
  • Owning the execution of partner campaigns across the funnel from recruitment to demand generation programs.
  • Engaging and elevating the partner community through exceptional content in partnership with the communication, product and alliances teams.
  • Multiplying our partners' impact through programmatic approaches.
  • Crafting bespoke plans and joint value propositions to stand out in the marketplace.
  • Championing our partner collaboration vision both internally and externally.
  • Managing the use of Marketing Development Funds (MDF) whether we receive it or distribute it.
  • Driving the adoption of advanced analytics and reporting tools to continually improve the ROI of partner marketing activities.
  • Mentoring and developing a diverse team of partner marketers covering our whole spectrum of partners.
  • Cultivating a culture of continuous testing and optimization.
What we are looking for in you
  • Strong understanding of the technology ecosystem including Silicon, IHV, ISV, ODM/OEMs, cloud service providers and channels is essential for this role.
  • Demonstrated leadership in aligning diverse partners around Go To Market strategies.

Isso significa criar e implementar programas e ações que impulsionem nossos líderes a crescerem, se desenvolverem e entregarem resultados alinhados aos nossos comportamentos desejados. Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.

Brex empowers the next generation of businesses with an integrated corporate card and spend management software. Brex proudly serves tens of thousands of growing businesses, from early-stage startups to global enterprises.
We are building the first AI-native Operations stack for growing companies — and we believe the same transformation should apply internally. As part of our BizOps team, you’ll be on the front lines of reinventing how operations work in the age of intelligent systems. This is a rare opportunity to join as a founding member of a new team, shaping not only the internal tools we build but also the way Brex runs. If you’re excited to build, not maintain — to experiment, not just optimize — this role is for you.
BizOps at Brex
The BizOps team sits at the intersection of strategy, systems, and execution. This new Technical Operations team will focus on building internal tools, automations, and intelligent workflows in platforms like Retool to power every team across the company. We're building a best-in-class AI-native operations org , and this role will be instrumental in turning that vision into reality.
What You’ll Do
You’ll partner cross-functionally with teams like Engineering, Operations, Product, Data, and Product to build tools that drive scale and efficiency. Your work will be highly visible, high-impact, and deeply technical — but not in the traditional engineering sense. You’ll use JavaScript, SQL , and business context to build the systems that run Brex.
Where you’ll work
This role will be based in our São Paulo office. You must be willing to work in office at least 2 days per week, on Wednesday and Thursday, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when we open our Sao Paulo office.
Employees will be able to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, for a minimum of one week at a time.

  • Actively explore and integrate new AI tools and frameworks into internal ops

  • Fluent in JavaScript, Python and/or SQL; you will be writing and reviewing code regularly
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to work through ambiguity with minimal guidance
  • Comfortable ramping up quickly on business context and cross-functional priorities
  • Experience building internal tools or automations that support non-technical users
Bonus points
  • Experience with tools like Retool, Salesforce, Hex, Looker, or OpenAI APIs

title: Senior Lead Technology Architect - Lyric Team
description:
Description

ADP is hiring a Senior Lead Technology Architect - Lyric Team

  • Are you empathetic to client needs and inspired by transformation and impacting the lives of millions of people every day?
  • Are you looking tojoin a dynamic, inclusiveteam environmentwith a culture of collaboration and belonging?

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to design what's next?

In this role, you will be the person who keeps our team on track and on time for new projects. Working alongside 7 to 14 team members, you remove roadblocks and keep developers coding. Whether it's coaching, cutting meetings short, or auditing the process - you'll do whatever it takes to keep the project moving.

To thrive in this role, you must understand the software development project lifecycle in an Agile environment have prior project management experience working in scrums or as a scrum master. Ideally, you've managed a project from inception to production at an enterprise level. Our best project managers show initiative, try new things and learn from their mistakes along the way. PMP certification is not required. You must be comfortable enough with code to decipher functions, and a technical coding background will help you be successful.As part of our team, you'll find exciting challenges,get opportunities to grow your career, and develop solid friendships as we design what's next for ADP and the industry.

Hybrid work model, reporting directly to our Porto Alegre Office location.

WHAT WE EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

Experience and Skills:

  • Solid experience in leading & managing multiple complex projects in agile environments (both Scrum and Kanban);
  • Excellent verbal & written communication skills and be able to communicate and adapt effectively to different audiences (team, management, executive, business etc);
  • Project & Process Management skills, including industry standard project management;
  • Experience in Project Management Tools such as Jira, MS SharePoint, Webex and MS Office & Project;
  • Experience working with offshore teams and project teams distributed across multiple time zones;
  • Strong knowledge of NodeJS, Java, Springboot, Kafka, PostegresSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB, Kubernets, Splunk;
  • Should be able to write clean code passing sonar quality gate passing;
  • Advanced English;
  • Proven experience dealing with challenging team members / personnel issues. On occasion you will be co-managing team members when managers are either remote (other countries) or are not directly involved in the project;
  • Excellent presentation skills and be able to present project updates in front of small or large groups.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • Scrums. You'll start each day with a scrum, working with a team to understand responsibilities, identify issues, and communicate coding priorities;
  • Coding. Working in two-week agile sprints, you must keep up with timelines and coding standards. Although your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time, you may need to dive in to review code, so your coding background will come in handy and contribute to your success;
  • Communications. You're the point of contact for the project. You'll share information with your teammates, mark milestones, and provide metrics and status updates to product owners and project sponsors;
  • Organization. As a project manager, you are very organized, and you keep everyone on task. Is a meeting going off-topic? You'll pull the team back to the agenda. Scope creeping? You'll stay on top of the schedule, remove barriers, identify dependencies, and mitigate risks;
  • Variety of tasks. There is no typical day. You could coach a teammate, deliver a status update to executives in other departments, or make sure we have deployed our resources in the best possible way. You will manage many competing priorities, so a fast pace should not scare you. You pride yourself on having flexibility and agility and can change directions without a second thought;
  • Servant Leadership. Your job is to help everyone else work better. What tasks or issues can you handle so your development team can keep working? What barriers can you remove?;

YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity;
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes;
  • Act like an owner & doer. Mission-driven and committed to leading change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft;
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation;
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

What are you waiting for? Apply today!

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Solutions Engineer in São Paulo, you will work closely with Sales and Account Management teams to drive success for Taboola’s advertisers. You will be responsible for onboarding new Advertisers, monitoring delivery and performance, resolving technical issues, and providing in-depth technical recommendations, and optimization strategies across a book of business. This includes troubleshooting complex database and backend technology issues.

The Solutions Engineer possesses great communication and presentation skills, and ability to understand all technical aspects of our client’s goal and objectives. The Solutions Engineer should be a fast learner and able to ramp up on the changing needs of the platform. Continuous learning and adaptability to change are critical parts of the job.

To thrive in this role, you'll need:
  • 2+ years of experience in a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager role
  • Experience working experience with SQL, JavaScript, and basic HTML
  • Experience working experience with Google Analytics and APIs
  • Experience working with Google Tag Manager or other tag management systems
  • Proven ability to strategically evaluate and drive client success through sales techniques such as effective questioning, objection handling, and strong customer service skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, and ability to translate technical investigations and analysis into actions for non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to run simple Data analysis and comparisons.
Bonus points if you have:
  • Experience with the ecosystem of ad networks, DSPs, audience targeting and technology, ad operations and ad buying
  • Experience with mobile measurement partners (e.g., Appsflyer, Adjust, Kochava, Branch)
  • Experience in tracking implementation methods (e.g., Shopify, DCM)
How you’ll make an impact:

As a Solutions Engineer you will:

  • Own responsibility for end-to-end technical onboarding processes, Taboola pixel implementation, conversion tracking, performance and health analysis.
  • Perform technical troubleshooting to identify and proactively solve issues.
  • Perform end-to-end campaign performance analysis, and provide delivery and optimization recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and clients, to increase revenue and KPI attainment.
  • Design methodologies and tools to improve customer service and troubleshooting ability
  • Build an in-depth knowledge of Taboola advertising products, and how they can be used to meet a wide range of marketing objectives.
  • Act as a technical expert on attribution and measurement, providing guidance on best practices, privacy-compliant tracking and data integration
  • Lead the technical integration of tracking and data collection tools across advertiser accounts, ensuring seamless implementation and data accuracy
  • Build technical solutions and automation workflows to scale measurement capabilities
  • Set up and manage data pipelines to collect, process, and analyze campaign performance data.
Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

  • Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO says; “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.
  • Well-being: Enjoy comprehensive benefits (health, dental, vision, 401k matching), pre-tax commuter benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and various gym partnerships.
  • Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office with an option to come in more often if desired.
  • Work with some of the biggest names: We work with some of the biggest names in the business. Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, Expedia and Honda.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn , Facebook , Instagram , X , YouTube , & the Taboola Life Blog .

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

4 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Enterprise Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective of reducing risk and churn, facilitating the adoption of new products or services, and supporting expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. By clearly understanding their customers' objectives, the CSM can align expectations, suggest a large range of additional services or product capacity to increase loyalty, alleviate any pain points, and help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue to offer thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open-source infrastructure and applications. To provide the appropriate level of focus for every customer, CSMs are specialized in one of the following segments:

  • Mass - SMEs or large businesses starting their journey with Canonical
  • Focus - Large companies with established ARR
  • Step Growth - a selection of high-potential customers
All CSMs contribute to business support at the company level for all remaining, not-yet-assigned customers (Tech segment), including our Store customers.
Location: This role will be based remotely.
What your day will look like
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Elaborate and coordinate complex projects in interaction with developers, IT managers and decision makers from various industries.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Field Engineering and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Manage a portfolio of customers in a specific geographic region and identify growth opportunities or renewal risks in coordination with Sales.
  • Experience running a disciplined, weekly customer and business review process with cross-functional teams, identifying and prioritizing blockers, and driving resolution through corporate product and engineering teams
  • Serve as a customer advocate internally and influence Canonical products roadmaps, Canonical websites, documentation, processes and people to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Supporting customers through reactive ticket requests.
  • Create campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
What we are looking for in you
The ideal candidate would display impeccable customer-facing skills with a passion for cloud and data centre infrastructure technologies. We are also looking for:
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience with a strong relation to IT and with exposure to projects related to at least one of these topics: Linux OS, data applications, storage, cloud computing, networking, security, migration, IoT.
  • Excellent presentation skills with the ability to guide a conversation about complex software.
  • Experience building and improving internal processes while maintaining timely delivery to customer-related projects.
  • A true team player capable of interacting with all departments and at all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies.
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Spanish and Portuguese alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • Experience with Salesforce, Jira and CRMs is a big plus!
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

PRAZER, NÓS SOMOS GRUPOLOS! ️
Com mais de seis décadas de experiência desde nossa fundação em 1959, somos uma força impulsionadora na logística nacional. No Grupo LOS , estamos orgulhosos de oferecer soluções logísticas excepcionais e de ser referência em proporcionar serviços integrados com agilidade, segurança e foco em resultados em todas as nossas operações.
Atualmente, o Grupo LOS conta com uma equipe de mais de 800 colaboradores dedicados, distribuídos em mais de 60 unidades estrategicamente localizadas de norte a sul do país. Essa abrangência nos permite oferecer serviços logísticos de alta qualidade em todo o território nacional, conectando pessoas, empresas e mercados.
O GRUPOLOS , composto pelas experientes transportadoras TRANSAGIL e TRANSLOS , possui mais de 60 anos de tradição na logística. Sua frota própria e agregada, respaldada por um centro de manutenção interno, assegura a qualidade e operacionalidade dos serviços. A expansão para além das estradas inclui a rede de postos PETROLOS , estrategicamente localizados para eficiente abastecimento da frota. A visão voltada para o futuro é impulsionada pela empresa SIGA+ , braço tecnológico que oferece soluções abrangentes de gestão de frota. A sinergia entre essas empresas torna o Grupo LOS uma referência inovadora, proporcionando aos clientes uma experiência logística única e eficaz.
O QUE BUSCAMOS?
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como Operador de Expedição em nossa unidade localizada em Recife/PE .
Missão do Cargo: Executar as atividades operacionais de separação, movimentação e carregamento de produtos, assegurando que os processos de expedição ocorram com agilidade, precisão e segurança, conforme os padrões estabelecidos pelo cliente.
PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:
  • Separação e Preparação de Cargas:
Realizar a separação de produtos conforme ordens de carregamento ou romaneios, garantindo o correto empilhamento e identificação para expedição.
  • Movimentação de Produtos:
Efetuar a movimentação física dos produtos (ensacados ou granel, conforme o tipo de operação), utilizando carrinhos hidráulicos, paleteiras ou equipamentos de movimentação (se habilitado).
  • Carregamento de Veículos:
Auxiliar no carregamento de caminhões, respeitando os critérios de segurança, empilhamento correto e disposição da carga conforme orientações do conferente.
  • Organização do Pátio e Doca:
Manter a área de expedição organizada, com os produtos posicionados adequadamente para facilitar o fluxo logístico e evitar avarias.
  • Apoio na Conferência:
Apoiar o conferente na verificação de quantidades e integridade dos volumes, garantindo que o que está sendo carregado corresponda ao pedido do cliente.
  • Zelar pela Segurança nas Operações:
Cumprir rigorosamente as normas de segurança, utilizar corretamente os EPIs, sinalizar áreas de risco e colaborar com a prevenção de acidentes.
  • Controle de Paletes e Embalagens:
Realizar o manuseio correto de paletes, bags ou outras embalagens utilizadas no transporte de cimento, contribuindo para o controle e conservação desses materiais.
  • Limpeza e Conservação do Ambiente de Trabalho:
Executar rotinas de limpeza da área de expedição e zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos e ferramentas utilizados.
REQUISITOS DESEJAVÉIS:
  • Experiência com operações logísticas de cargas pesadas;
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho em ambientes industriais/logísticos;
  • Desejável conhecimento em expedição de cimento ensacado ou a granel;
  • Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira (caso atue com esse equipamento).

What does the Sales Solutions Architecture Team do?
Sales Solution Architects work in partnership with Solutions Specialists (Sales Representatives) and serve as their technical counterparts in all phases of the sales lifecycle. From evangelizing technologies to demonstrating our feature-rich Cloud Reliability Platform, our job is to help customers figure out and solve their cloud initiatives. We do this by taking a consultative approach in our discovery and assessment phases with the output being solutions that are built with reliability, performance, and security baked-in on top of our Managed Cloud Portfolio. As an integral part of the Solutions Architecture team, you will design systems that are purpose-built and well suited to their target infrastructure.
What You'll Do
As a Solution Architect you will:

  • Provide Pre-Sales technical support to the GTM Team to drive revenue and cloud adoption
  • Conduct full technical discovery and assessment workshops to identify pain points and gather business and technical requirements. This will include Well-Architected Reviews, Migration Readiness Assessments, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis, etc.
  • You will architect client solutions to meet client requirements using a well architected framework methodology
  • Clearly communicate proposed architectures in the pre-sales cycle for early validation and verification to the internal teams responsible for implementing and providing ongoing support
  • Be a technology evangelist and educate prospects and customers on the cloud solution that makes the most sense for their business and technology requirements
  • Interface with Product Marketing and provide feedback for improving product quality and capabilities by leveraging information gathered in field engagements
  • Collaborate in the creation of technical collateral (e.g. SOWs, HLDs), and help develop sales staff by providing formal training
  • Produce cost and labor estimates and SOWs for potential projects
  • Provide thought leadership by speaking at industry events such as trade shows, panels or marketing events as well as publishing blog posts, white papers and participating in case studies

  • Relevant Industry-leading certification required: AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect - Expert)
  • Deep understanding of the following Public Cloud Platforms: Microsoft Azure, AWS
  • Understanding of containerization & virtualization technologies; e.g Kubernetes, Docker
  • Understanding of IAAS / PAAS / SAAS platforms; e.g. EC2, VMs, etc.
  • Understanding IaC tools; e.g. Puppet, Ansible, ARM/Bicep, Terraform
  • Understanding of different Disaster Recovery and data protection principles
  • Understanding of PCI, HIPAA, GDPR regulatory compliance frameworks
  • Understanding of Relational and Non-Relational Databases (MySQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, NoSQL)
  • Expertise in networking, compute, storage and OS fundamentals
What General Attributes We're Looking For In You
Ideal candidate must be enthusiastic, a self-starter, and willing to step up to new challenges. Must be comfortable in the dynamic atmosphere of a technical organization with a rapidly expanding customer base.
  • A BA/BS Degree with 6+ years of experience, or a MS Degree with 4+ years of experience, or a Ph.D with one year of experience, or 10 years of overall experience without a degree
  • Background and experience working in the context of a sales team
  • Strong presentation, written and verbal communication skills

  • They have cultivated strong interpersonal skills and have experience initiating and building positive relationships
  • They are comfortable within a rapidly changing technical environment and are comfortable with ambiguity
What makes this an exciting opportunity?
Working at a high-growth company is exciting on many levels. You'll have wide latitude to grow your technical skills and the company actively encourages learning and pays you to gain industry recognized certifications. You'll find unusually broad opportunities to expand your knowledge and grow your career. New ideas and lateral thinking are the norm, and you'll find your team and other cross-functional groups are receptive to them, because everything you do here is visible and matters. title: Software Engineer I (Remote)
description:
We're revolutionizing the fitness & wellness industry, and we’re looking for talented people to help us do it. Mindbody + ClassPass bring together the best of both sides of the market: Mindbody is the industry’s most trusted all-in-one technology platform; ClassPass is one of the most popular apps for fitness & self-care enthusiasts. Together we’re partnering with more than 70,000 fitness studios, gyms, salons, and spas around the world. We’re not just another tech company—we’re far and away the leader of our industry. So join the team, work with mission-led people, and enjoy amazing benefits. Let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Who we are
We’re a passionate engineering, platform, and operations team, developing and supporting ground-breaking products. Together, we’ll build for the future, creating more opportunities for wellness businesses around the world to help their customers lead full, healthy lives. We push ourselves and our company to always strive for this higher purpose, recognizing the power in working together toward the same goal. We believe in building a diverse company where everyone feels safe bringing their authentic selves to work. And we believe that the secret to success is our people. Join the team, and let’s see what we can accomplish together!
Your role
As a Software Engineer I, you’ll be a part of a team working to build secure systems for the Mindbody ecosystem. You’ll pursue continuous improvement to help Mindbody achieve its mission: Powering the world’s fitness and wellness businesses and connecting them with more consumers, more effectively, than anyone else.
You'll likely spend time working on

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and QA to iterate on the design, implementation and deployment of our product.
  • Build and maintain backend systems and applications, tightly scoped work with supervision and support.
  • Navigating code reviews thoughtfully and constructively contributing to conversations around pull requests.
  • Participating in retrospectives as a constructive team member.
  • Seek different perspectives and solicit honest feedback.
  • Practice engineering best practices (e.g., automated testing, code reviews, proper monitoring).
  • Learning one or more technical areas and becoming increasingly comfortable contributing to your team’s codebase.
  • Take delight in delighting our users.
  • Care about our studio partners and want to help them grow their business
About the right team member
You know the best platform is created through collaboration and iteration and you’re looking for the right opportunity, and the right team, to expand your experience. You seek feedback because it can turn good work into great work. You are naturally curious and enjoy learning from those around you. You're not afraid to ask questions early and often when navigating new code or systems. You take initiative to solve clearly defined problems, and you welcome constructive feedback as part of your growth. You strive to contribute positively to your team’s culture and take pride in doing thoughtful work.
At Mindbody+ClassPass we value people who are intellectually curious, who are pragmatic not dogmatic, and people who care about our product, their teammates, and their own personal growth. We are faced with an interesting set of technical challenges, and we believe in giving our engineers the autonomy to go and solve them. Much of our team comes from non-traditional computing backgrounds; we know that by bringing together a diverse set of voices we’ll be able to build a better product, and a better company. We care less about what languages or frameworks you know, and care more that you are excited to produce high-quality code and be constantly learning. Our engineers work in cross-functional teams that are focused on impact, and movement between teams is encouraged. We work very closely with our brilliant product team to deliver a world class user experience, and ultimately to empower our users to live their fullest, healthiest lives.
You'll thrive in this role with experience in
  • 0-2 years of experience in programming large-scale SaaS products.
  • Experience building backend services with an object-oriented language such as C# or Java.
  • Experience designing and architecting backend services.
  • Experience designing and working with Microservice architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring systems such as New Relic or Kibana.
  • Familiarity with SDLC and programming design patterns, and Agile methodology.
  • Experience reviewing new feature's impact on an application and recognizing potential risks.
  • Detail-oriented, professional and possesses a positive work attitude.
  • Ability to communicate professionally both verbally and in writing.
Technologies you'll be working with
  • Experience building highly performant and high-quality backends. We use Kotlin, .Net, Python, C#, React and Ruby in our stack but we're most interested in your experience building great systems.
  • Understanding of SQL and relational databases.
Have we piqued your curiosity?
Sound like the role for you? We’d love to hear from you! Even if you’re not 100% sure about potential fit, we still encourage you to apply. We’re looking for the right person, not the perfect series of checkboxes.

description:
Sobre o Banco de Talentos

Após o cadastro em nosso Banco de Talentos, seus dados ficarão armazenados em nossos bancos de dados e disponíveis para análise dos nossos especialistas de recrutamento, quando houver vagas abertas.

Se eu me inscrever, eu vou automaticamente participar de um processo de recrutamento?

Ao candidatar-se no nosso banco de talentos o seu perfil ficará mapeado para futuras vagas, os perfis que tiverem compatibilidade poderão ser convidados para participar do processo seletivo através do e-mail cadastrado.

Caso você tenha interesse em posições de analista de atendimento ao cliente, ouvidoria, prevenção a fraudes e outras, inscreva-se ao final desta página.

Quem pode se inscrever?

Todas as pessoas com deficiência podem se inscrever nessa página e em qualquer outra vaga na nossa página de carreiras.

Se eu não me identificar como pessoa com deficiência, posso me inscrever?

Este é um banco de talentos para pessoas com deficiência e que desejam fazer parte do time do Nubank, caso você não se identifique como parte desse grupo, confira nossas outras oportunidades na nossa página de carreiras

Sobre nós

O Nubank nasceu em 2013 com a missão de combater a complexidade para empoderar as pessoas no seu dia a dia, reinventando os serviços financeiros. Somos uma das maiores plataformas de banco digital do mundo, atendendo a milhões de clientes no Brasil, México e Colômbia. Para mais informações acesse nossa página institucional

Sobre as áreas

Atendimento ao cliente: A área é formada por Xpeers, composta por pessoas responsáveis por criar relacionamentos significativos com cada um dos nossos clientes, fornecendo uma experiência excelente para criar uma comunidade de clientes apaixonados pelo Nubank.

Dentro da área de atendimento existem diversas segmentações que tratam assuntos diferentes, como por exemplo:

  1. Atendimento ao cliente alta renda: Esse segmento do Nubank, busca proporcionar uma experiência exclusiva e oferecer uma curadoria de produtos e serviços exclusivos criada para que os nossos clientes possam desfrutar o melhor dos momentos, todos os dias.
  2. Atendimento de grande sensibilidade: Especializado em lidar com situações sensíveis, como assaltos ou sequestros, o atendimento ocorre por diferentes canais (telefone, chat, ticket, etc.). Esses casos são registrados, analisados e encaminhados internamente para resolução.
  3. Atendimento ao cliente - área gerais: Oferece suporte a produtos financeiros em diversos canais, esse tipo de atendimento visa resolver dúvidas, analisar informações e encaminhar casos internamente. O objetivo é proporcionar uma experiência eficiente e única aos nossos clientes.

Como é o dia a dia de uma pessoa na área de Atendimento ao Cliente?

  • Oferece suporte e soluciona dúvidas sobre os produtos e serviços oferecidos pelo Nubank por meio de diferentes canais, como telefone, chat e e-mail.
  • Analisa informações e registra dados relevantes durante o atendimento para futuras referências.
  • Encaminha casos internamente quando necessário, trabalhando em colaboração com outras áreas para resolver problemas complexos.
  • Preocupa-se em oferecer uma experiência de atendimento eficiente, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Detém conhecimento sobre as políticas e regulamentos do Nubank, para fornecer informações precisas e adequadas aos clientes.
  • Demonstra empatia e compreensão ao lidar com reclamações ou situações sensíveis, buscando soluções satisfatórias para ambas as partes.

Ouvidoria:

A Ouvidoria tem como objetivo ser um canal de segunda instância para nossos clientes endereçarem seus problemas, entregando uma experiência pessoal, ética, imparcial e de alta qualidade. O time tem como compromisso reconquistar a confiança dos nossos clientes, preservar a credibilidade junto aos órgãos reguladores e manter a nossa reputação perante o mercado. Além disso, buscamos trazer a voz do cliente para dentro do Nubank, compartilhando suas experiências, visando o aprimoramento de produtos, serviços e processos, sendo uma referência em cuidado ao cliente em situações críticas.

Como é o dia a dia de uma pessoa na área de Ouvidoria?

  • Recebe, analisa e responde demandas dos clientes por meio dos canais da Ouvidoria (0800, e-mail, Consumidor.Gov, RDR, Procon, Reclame Aqui, Social Media), identificando a causa raiz das manifestações e propondo planos de ação efetivos para os casos procedentes;
  • Interage quando necessário com as áreas responsáveis na busca de soluções efetivas aos pontos relatados pelo cliente;
  • Elabora e revisa as devolutivas a serem comunicadas aos clientes, sendo guardião do tom de voz Nubank;
  • Contribui para o desenvolvimento e melhoria dos processos do Nubank por meio de insights oferecidos pelos nossos clientes;
  • Estabelece uma relação de confiança e transparência com o cliente, demonstrando a preocupação que temos em reconquistar a sua confiança e satisfação, através de atendimentos e produtos que superem todas as expectativas.

Prevenção a Fraudes (Financial Crime Investigations): Desempenha um papel fundamental na proteção dos clientes contra atividades criminosas e fraudulentas, cumprindo com as regulamentações necessárias para garantir a continuidade do nosso negócio. O time analisa casos em que há risco regulatório, reputacional e financeiro resultante de uma ação fraudulenta.

Como é o dia a dia de uma pessoa na área de Prevenção a Fraudes?

  • Analisa transações e atividades suspeitas com o objetivo de identificar possíveis fraudes.
  • Utiliza ferramentas e sistemas especializados para monitorar e verificar informações financeiras.
  • Detém conhecimento sobre novas técnicas e tendências de fraudes, a fim de desenvolver contramedidas eficazes.

Data Labeler:

A área é responsável por realizar a rotulação de processos das mais diversas frentes de negócios, com o objetivo de garantir o enriquecimento de dados, textos ou imagens, aprimorando nossos modelos de análise.

Como é o dia a dia de uma pessoa em Data Labeling?

  • Recebe projetos de data labeling e suas respectivas diretrizes para entender os requisitos de marcação de dados.
  • Utiliza ferramentas e plataformas específicas para rotular e marcar dados de acordo com as instruções fornecidas.
  • Analisa e interpreta diferentes tipos de dados, como texto, imagens ou áudio, conforme necessário.
  • Garante a qualidade e consistência das marcações, seguindo os padrões estabelecidos e realizando revisões quando necessário.

Para estas áreas, procuramos por uma pessoa que

  • Tenha experiência em canais de atendimento ao cliente;
  • Tenham domínio da norma culta da língua portuguesa.
  • Tenham criatividade para encontrar soluções para demandas diversas.
  • Flexibilidade para se adaptar a diferentes perfis de clientes.
  • Experiência em solucionar problemas.
  • Experiência com ferramentas tecnológicas (Office ou Google Sheets).

Será um diferencial se

  • Experiência anterior com fraude ou casos sensíveis como Reclame Aqui ou Ouvidoria;
  • Cursos relacionados à fraude (Ex: Documentoscopia, Grafoscopia)
  • Experiência de trabalho anterior em serviços premium/exclusivos.
  • Habilidade de análise de dados.
  • Habilidade de melhoria de processo/ entrega.
  • Inglês básico.

Nosso Nu Way of Working

O nosso modelo de trabalho tem ciclos que podem variar de dois a três meses de acordo com a área de atuação. Ou seja, para cada oito ou doze semanas de trabalho remoto, uma será no escritório.

Diversidade & Inclusão

No Nu, queremos ter certeza de que estamos construindo um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo, que reflita os clientes que atendemos e procuramos empoderar. É por isso que contratamos com base na igualdade. Consideramos gênero, etnia, raça, religião, orientação sexual e outros marcadores de identidade como elementos-chave para nossa empresa, garantindo que nenhum deles represente uma barreira ao recrutar pessoas talentosas.

title: Analista de Sales Operations (Sales Ops)
description:
Sua Missão:
Transformar a área de vendas em uma operação baseada em dados e eficiência, elevando as taxas de fechamento e contribuindo para o crescimento da empresa. Você atuará como o elo entre a estratégia e sua aplicação prática, eliminando ruídos e aumentando a produtividade do time de vendas.

Sua atuação será nos bastidores, mas você precisa amar a área e as métricas de vendas, usando ferramentas para levantar e analisar dados. Com isso, poder descobrir eventuais falhas nos processos, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e indicar as melhores estratégias para a equipe de vendas, tudo com a finalidade de tornar o time de vendas mais produtivo, focado em fazer negócios melhores.

Você ajudará também a pensar em marketing ops, no que cabe os indicadores de geração de demanda via inbound e outras origens de negócios para o time comercial, auxiliando a definir os processos e tecnologias necessários para que a área funcione da melhor maneira possível.

Você atuará com o CRM do Hubspot, tanto em vendas, quanto em marketing.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Análise de Dados:

    • Analisar diariamente as métricas de vendas (aquisição e expansão) e marketing vinculadas ao processo de vendas dentro do Hubspot.
    • Responsável pelo acompanhamento e análise semanal e mensal da performance de vendas.
    • Identificar, rastrear e comunicar KPIs sobre o desempenho de vendas da divisão para a alta gerência.
    • Ser o braço direito na análise de dados do líder de vendas.
    • Tratar e entregar visões de análises para o analista de negócios de Revenue Ops.
    • Duvidar dos números e resultados, sempre garantindo a integridade dos dados.

  2. Alinhamento Estratégico:

    • Atuar nas dimensões estratégicas, táticas e operacionais da empresa, lidando com C-level, gerentes e time de vendas.
    • Fazer o alinhamento entre a estratégia e sua aplicação no mercado para eliminar ruídos e aumentar a eficácia e produtividade da equipe.
    • Implementar e manter um processo claro de gerenciamento de pipeline.
    • Apoiar a definição de metas de vendas trimestrais e atividades de previsão com desenvolvimento de negócios e operações de vendas.
    • Propor sugestões sobre o processo de vendas com base em análise de dados.

  3. Suporte ao Time:

    • Garantir que o time de vendas esteja preenchendo corretamente o CRM e outros sistemas relacionados (Apollo), atuando como o guardião do CRM.
    • Ser solícito para esclarecer dúvidas sobre o Hubspot e entendimento de métricas para o time.
    • Organizar capacitações sobre o Hubspot para o time e coordenar junto ao líder de vendas.
    • Ajudar no onboarding de novos colaboradores no uso do Hubspot.

    • Participar dos ritos semanais do time de marketing e vendas às segundas e sextas, além das dailies.
    • Responder às demandas internas do time de modo ágil e solícito;
    • Cumprir prazos e cronogramas.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Would you like to work with meaningful products that help protect the environment and people? In our team, you’ll be part of developing and delivering tomorrow's solutions for oil spill response and high-pressure tents, as well as specialized products for industries like aquaculture and fisheries.

Employment Type

Permanent

NorLense is engaged in developing and producing oil spill response equipment that contributes to safeguarding clean seas and coastlines. Our high-pressure tents serve as field hospitals worldwide, among other uses. The position in our technical department offers strong opportunities for personal growth and influence in a vibrant and forward-thinking environment. As we’re expanding, we’re looking for more talented and friendly team members!

Roles and Job Tasks

  • Preparation of technical drawings, production documentation, and production structures
  • Product manager for various products and product groups
  • Follow-up and support for production
  • Technical support to the sales department and customers
  • The position reports to the Technical Manager
  • Some travel may be required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Civil Engineer, Engineer, or equivalent technical qualification
  • Experience in project management
  • Proficiency in CAD software, such as SolidWorks and AutoCAD, or similar tools
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Norwegian and English
  • Solid IT knowledge and experience using Microsoft 365

We are seeking someone like you as...

  • Eager to explore new domains and technology.
  • Able to work methodically and analytically.
  • Performs well in a high-energy work setting and collaborates effectively with others.
  • Focused on creative problem-solving for both large and small issues.

Applications will be processed on an ongoing basis.

About NorLense

NorLense AS is a leading supplier in the development and production of equipment for oil spill response, field preparedness (tents), and aquaculture. Established in 1975, the company has been a pioneer in its field ever since.

Operating in a demanding and quality-focused market, NorLense has built a strong reputation as a provider of emergency equipment for clients such as the defense sector, NATO, and international aquaculture businesses.

Currently, we have more than 50 employees and are consistently growing. The owners have a long-term vision with clear goals for expansion. The business is managed from our headquarters in Fiskebøl, located in the heart of Lofoten and Vesterålen, and we also have sales offices in Sandvika, the UK, Rio de Janeiro (Brazil), and Dampier (Australia).

The Front-End Engineer will be responsible for delivering high-quality, performant, and user-centered applications, contributing to position BotCity among the best RPA solutions in the Automation market. We are seeking a highly motivated professional with proven experience in front-end development, preferably in product-focused companies with complex projects, and excited about collaborating with Product/UX/UI teams with a can-do attitude and interested in leading a team in the future (previous tech lead experience preferred but not required). This role will be part of the Product Team.
Responsibilities
About the Role

  • Develop, deploy, and maintain scalable, responsive web applications using modern front-end technologies (focus on desktop with some mobile, which could evolve with time).
  • Collaborate with product managers and UX/UI designers to understand requirements, ensure its technical feasibility, and translate them into technical, user-friendly solutions.

  • Identify and troubleshoot front-end issues to ensure a seamless user experience.
  • Write reusable code and libraries for future use, optimizing components for maximum speed.
Requisitos

  • Proven professional experience (5+ years) in front-end development, preferably in product-focused companies and working in complex projects alongside Product/UX/UI teams.

  • Experience in building responsive layouts and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and working alongside back-end development teams.
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth, JWT, or SAML.
  • Experience with version control and project management systems, particularly Git and GitHub.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Prior experience in an early-stage, high-growth and fast-paced startup (or similar) environment.
  • Ability to travel as needed to meet the team.
  • English - Advanced (Reading, Comprehension, and Writing).
Nice to Haves
  • Experience with Webpack, Babel, and other build tools for optimizing front-end workflows.
  • Knowledge of HTTP caching mechanisms, including ETags, Cache-Control headers, and stale-while-revalidate patterns.
  • Understanding of web application security principles, such as OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities. Experience with secure data storage and handling sensitive information (e.g., encryption, tokenization).
  • Understanding of session management, including techniques for mitigating session hijacking and session fixation attacks.
  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Cypress) for front-end applications.

Company Overview

Decskill, founded in 2014 as an IT Consulting Company, values its people as its greatest asset. With over 600 professionals and offices in Lisbon, Porto, Madrid, and Luxembourg, we operate across three core areas:

  • Experience with Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) Gen 2.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tools, especially Azure DevOps.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of Azure Logic Apps, Azure Stream Analytics, Azure API Management, and Microsoft Purview.
